async def act(page):
    # Click on the project link to navigate to the project details page
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Convex Eggtart / Super_Awesome_Robot', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    # Wait for the project details page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the SSH clone command; typically in a textbox with name 'Clone with SSH'
    ssh_clone_element = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Clone with SSH')
    ssh_command = await ssh_clone_element.input_value()
    return ssh_command
